tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List prediction markets on real-world transport outcomes (flight delays, train punctuality, ship arrivals, weekly ship counts through maritime chokepoints, airport flight counts), filtered by status (OPEN by default; CLOSED, SETTLED or CANCELLED for past ones), category and a free-text query matched

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: One market by id or slug: its question, the rule it settles on, route, outcomes with current prices, volume, close time, status and, once settled, the outcome it settled on, with a link to its page.

tools.name: get_market_price_history
tools.description: How a market's prices moved: up to 180 timestamped points, oldest first, each with one price per outcome (in outcome order, 0 to 1). Shows how the market's view of an outcome changed over its life, including for closed and settled markets.

tools.name: get_flight_status
tools.description: Live status of a flight by number (e.g. BA117 or BAW117). Returns the canonical flight number, the leg in the air or next to depart (or the most recent one), its departure and arrival times in UTC and airport-local time with the time zone, delay in minutes, the last update time, a link to the flight

tools.name: get_flight_history
tools.description: How often a flight has been late over the last 30 days. Returns on-time, late and cancelled counts, n (arrivals with a recorded arrival time), the window, the late rule with its minute threshold, and a link to the flight page on gaduin.com.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Today's departures from an airport still to leave (airport-local day), optionally only those to one destination or flown by one airline: finds flights without knowing their number. Each flight has its number, operating flight for codeshares, destination, scheduled and actual departure in UTC, status

tools.name: get_airline_stats
tools.description: An airline's last 30 days of the flights it operates itself: arrivals, on-time and late counts with the on-time share, cancellations, diversions, median and 90th-percentile arrival delay, routes flown, its most and least delayed flights, the late rule, and a link to its airline page on gaduin.com.

tools.name: get_airport_status
tools.description: How an airport is running today (airport-local day): its status (severe, disrupted, normal, quiet or no_data), disruption score (0-1, the worse side), which side is worse, and for departures and arrivals the flights scheduled, completed, delayed and cancelled, the delayed, cancelled and disrupted sh

tools.name: list_disrupted_airports
tools.description: Today's most disrupted airports, worst first: those rated disrupted or severe, each with the same reading as get_airport_status and a link to its page on gaduin.com. Empty when none is disrupted.

tools.name: get_station_board
tools.description: Live departures and arrivals at a railway station found by name or station code: for each train still to come, the other end of its journey, scheduled, expected and actual times in UTC, platform, status, delay, operator and, when one is open, a link to its market; plus the coming hour's departures,

tools.name: list_chokepoints
tools.description: Every maritime chokepoint with a published daily ship count (Suez, Panama, Hormuz, Malacca and more), furthest below normal first: slug, name, status (open, elevated, disrupted, closed or unknown), recent daily mean as a share of normal, the newest day counted, and a link to its page on gaduin.com.

tools.name: get_chokepoint_status
tools.description: Ship traffic through one maritime chokepoint: status, the recent daily mean against normal, the newest daily count, how many weeks it has been below normal and since when, the last 8 weekly totals with their share of normal, the last 14 daily counts, the rule behind the status, and a link to its pag

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_flights" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Today's departures from an airport still to leave (airport-local day), optionally only those to one destination or flown by one airline: finds flights without knowing their number. Each flight has its number, operating flight for codeshares, destination, scheduled and actual departure in UTC, status" → after: "Today's departures from an airport still to leave (airport-local day), optionally only those to one destination or flown by one airline: finds flights without knowing their number. Each flight has its number, operating flight for codeshares, destination, scheduled and actual departure in UTC, status"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
